title: Sysadmin Health Check
description: Routine system health check for the domestic-automation-daemon infrastructure. Verifies that core services are running, logs are healthy, and disk space is adequate.

constraints: - You MUST run `sudo systemctl status caddy --no-pager -n 5`
- You MUST verify that the service state is 'active (running)'
- You SHOULD check the last few journal lines for errors
rail.validation: Report the caddy service status (active/inactive/failed) and any errors found in recent journal output.

constraints: - You MUST run `df -h /` and `df -h /home`
- You MUST verify that no partition is above 85% usage
- You SHOULD check /tmp for large stale files
rail.validation: Report disk usage percentages for / and /home, and flag any partitions above 85%.

constraints: - You MUST run `crontab -l` to verify the cron configuration is intact
- You MUST check `tail -20 agents/home-agent/logs/agent_cron.log` for recent activity
- You MUST verify at least one cron-triggered agent run has occurred in the last 60 minutes
rail.validation: Report whether cron is configured, when the last agent run occurred, and whether any errors appear in the cron log.

constraints: - You MUST check `tail -20 agents/home-agent/logs/heartbeat_cron.log` for recent activity
- You MUST verify the heartbeat schedule file exists at `bin/heartbeat-scheduler/heartbeat_scheduler.json`
- You SHOULD list today's scheduled heartbeat tasks and check if they fired
rail.validation: Report whether the heartbeat scheduler is running, the last few executed tasks, and any missed schedules.

constraints: - You MUST run `free -h` to check memory usage
- You MUST run `uptime` to check system load
- You MUST verify swap usage is below 50%
- You SHOULD check for zombie processes with `ps aux | grep -c defunct`
rail.validation: Report system load averages, memory usage (used/total), swap usage, and zombie process count.

constraints: - You MUST compile the findings from all previous tasks into a concise summary
- You MUST flag any issues that need human attention
- You SHOULD suggest fixes for any problems found
- You MAY create a Todoist task on the LLM-Agent board for any issues requiring follow-up
rail.validation: Provide a final summary of system health with 'All Clear' or a list of issues requiring attention.
